一次只能刪除同一專案的任務。: Only issues in the same project can be deleted together.
Category 群組與類別標籤不可刪除。: The Category group and its labels cannot be deleted.
此團隊仍有專案，請先處理所屬專案。: This team still has projects. Move or delete its projects first.
儲存失敗，請重試。原有資料已保留。: Save failed. Please retry. Existing data has been preserved.
無法轉移封存紀錄：仍有其他紀錄使用它，請先處理相關資料。: Cannot move this archived record while other records reference it. Resolve those references first.
關聯目標已封存，請先還原。: The relation target is archived. Restore it first.
原操作包含已永久刪除的紀錄。: The original operation contains permanently deleted records.
原操作的紀錄已刪除或移至垃圾桶。: The original operation's record was deleted or moved to trash.
關聯必須屬於同一專案。: Related records must belong to the same project.
團隊狀態需為不重複、非空白的字串陣列。: Team states must be a nonempty array of unique, nonempty strings.
狀態仍被任務或 View 使用，不可移除：{0}: States referenced by issues or Views cannot be removed: {0}
團隊代碼需為 2–10 個大寫英數字。: Team keys must contain 2–10 uppercase letters or digits.
標籤結構建立後不可變更，請建立新群組。: Label structure cannot be changed after creation. Create a new group.
相同群組中已有此標籤。: This label already exists in the group.
Category 必須是單選群組。: Category must be a single-select group.
Done 只能由使用者驗收後設定。: Only a user can set Done after acceptance.
請選擇同團隊的子標籤，不可套用群組本身。: Select child labels from the same team, rather than label groups.
每張 issue 必須且只能有一個對應的 Category 子標籤。: Each issue must have exactly one matching Category child label.
父子 issue 不可形成循環。: Parent and child issues cannot form a cycle.
已核准 JPG 清單需要畫面規格文件。: Register approved JPGs on a Screen specification document.
已核准 JPG 缺少來源資料。: An approved JPG reference is missing source details.
已核准 JPG 雜湊無效。: The approved JPG hash is invalid.
JPG 與已核准的設計範圍不符。: The JPG does not match the approved design scope.
已繼承核准的 JPG 不可變更來源資料；請新增參考。: This JPG inherits approval for its original source details. Add a new reference to change them.
附件來源與檔案雜湊由系統管理。: LinearBoard manages attachment provenance and file hashes.
只有使用者可以核准視覺參考。: Only a user can approve visual references.
附件連結需使用 HTTP 或 HTTPS。: Attachment links must use HTTP or HTTPS.
關聯需為同專案的不同 issues。: Relations must connect different issues in the same project.
阻擋關係不可形成循環。: Blocking relations cannot form a cycle.
交付批次只包含 FE／BE issues。: Delivery batches can contain only FrontEnd or BackEnd issues.
Issue 不屬於所選里程碑。: The issue does not belong to the selected milestone.
此 issue 已有進行中的派工。: This issue already has an active dispatch.
每筆派工負責一張 issue；批次可包含多筆派工。: Each dispatch owns one issue. A batch may contain several dispatches.
執行前需記錄已審閱的計畫。: Record a reviewed plan before execution.
完成回報不可空白。: The completion report cannot be empty.
最多三筆進行中的派工。: At most three dispatches can be active at once.
驗證需填寫條件與環境。: Verification requires a criterion and an environment.
篩選條件需為 JSON object。: Filters must be a JSON object.
此 idempotency key 已用於不同內容。: This idempotency key was already used with different content.
請使用垃圾桶操作修改刪除狀態。: Use trash operations to change deletion state.
不支援封存；請使用垃圾桶。: Archiving is not supported. Use the trash.
此紀錄已變更，請重新讀取後再儲存。: This record has changed. Reload it before saving.
請上傳檔案或提供連結。: Upload a file or provide a link.
批次操作只接受任務、版本與狀態。: Bulk operations accept only issues, versions, and status.
每個任務都需要對應的版本。: Each issue requires its current version.
一次只能更新同一專案的任務。: Only issues in the same project can be updated together.
{0} 已變更；本次未更新任何任務，請重新讀取後再試。: {0} has changed. No issues were updated. Reload and try again.
該次刪除已還原或清除。: This deletion was already restored or purged.
相關紀錄已變更，請重新確認刪除影響。: Related records have changed. Review the deletion impact again.
有無法安全解除的關聯，請先處理。: Some relations cannot be safely detached. Resolve them first.
垃圾桶資料不完整，無法還原。: The trash data is incomplete and cannot be restored.
請先還原所屬團隊、專案或上層紀錄。: Restore the owning team, project, or parent record first.
請選擇要永久刪除的垃圾桶紀錄。: Select trashed records to delete permanently.
垃圾桶內容已變更，請重新確認。: The trash contents have changed. Review them again.
其他紀錄仍參照這些項目，請先還原或刪除相關紀錄。: Other records still reference these items. Restore or delete those records first.
